tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The page colour of every page other than home. It follows the hour: light from about 05:30 through golden hour, dark from about 18:30. The home page has no page colour of its own: its scene runs full bleed, and leaving it dissolves the scene into this.

tokens.name: page-dark
tokens.usage: The dark page colour, from sunset to dawn. Scene components blend toward it by hour.

tokens.name: page-light
tokens.usage: The light page colour, through the day. Scene components blend toward it by hour.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and links on `page`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `page`: inactive nav words, socials, dates, readouts. 5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Link underlines, rules, control borders and slider tracks on `page`. Dark meets 3:1 (3.1:1); light is 2.7:1 on `page-light`, so it is decorative only (see direction.md, Decisions for review).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: The settings panel's fill, over the scene, with a 6px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 1px, offset 3px.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: A raised layer on `page`: the experience hover card, project plates, the code snippet. One step off the page, never a second colour.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The only shadow in the system: floating cards that cover text (ExperienceCard). Never on cards in the flow.

tokens.name: caption-fill
tokens.usage: Pills and controls laid over photos and media, in every theme: they sit on the image, not the page. 6px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: caption-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `caption-fill`.

tokens.name: caption-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `caption-fill`: the film and year after a photo's title.

tokens.name: scene-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the home page. It sits on the scene's ground, which is dark at every hour, so it stays light whatever the page theme.

tokens.name: scene-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the home page: the slash between links, the hint.

tokens.name: scene-hairline
tokens.usage: Link underlines on the home page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Currently studying Computer Science at McGill University.
styles.usage: Bios, prose and descriptions. Headings are body at weight 500, never a display face. The home bio grows to 3vh line height on tall screens.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one larger size: the flagship project's name. Everything else is body or smaller.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hover cards and dense secondary text.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Labels, buttons and readouts in the settings panel.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: The top bar's lowercase words; 13px under 480px wide.

styles.name: link
styles.usage: Quiet link rows (socials): `ink-muted`, no underline, weight 600 on hover. Mono keeps every weight the same width, so nothing moves.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, kinds, captions and hints, in `ink-muted`. Replaces the old italic display `hint`: there is no serif or italic anywhere.

styles.name: glyph
styles.usage: The garden's type. Size follows the cell: 0.78 x cell height. Moves from IBM Plex Mono to Geist Mono when the garden is ported (see direction.md).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; between buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Settings panel padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between the bio and its links; inset of floating UI from the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between nav words; the top bar's top padding; between project rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Under the top bar, before the page's content; under each project row.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter below 1024px. From 1024px up it is 20vw, the same as the koi pond page.

tokens.name: hero-bottom
tokens.usage: Space under the bio on the home page; 48px when the window is under 720px tall.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Widest the bio runs.

tokens.name: measure-read
tokens.usage: Widest a reading paragraph runs off home: project descriptions, posts.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, buttons, images, plates: everything in the flow is square.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Slider thumbs only.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Markers: the orbit dot, firefly glow.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Floating cards and caption details only (ExperienceCard, PhotoCaption details). Stanley's reference, 2026-10-29.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills over media: photo captions, gallery counters and arrows.

tokens.name: cell-width
tokens.usage: Glyph cell width at 1100px wide: viewport width ÷ 170, between 5 and 16px.

tokens.name: cell-aspect
tokens.usage: Cell height ÷ width.

tokens.name: specimen-head
tokens.usage: Fewest cells a flower head may span and still read as a flower. Smaller ones are texture.

tokens.name: veil-duration
tokens.usage: Leaving the home page, page colour closes over the scene from the edges in, eased, over this long. Coming back it lifts the same way; the bio fades in 0.6s after.

tokens.name: veil-edge
tokens.usage: Width of the soft band the veil leads with: 26% in from the sides, 24% from the top, deeper at the bottom.

tokens.name: ease-calm
tokens.usage: Every UI transition: quick to start, soft to land.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Colour and weight changes on hover.

tokens.name: duration-card
tokens.usage: A hover card's fade and 4px rise. Closing waits 120ms so the pointer can cross into the card.

tokens.name: duration-leave
tokens.usage: Proposed (Ticket 2): leaving home, the page colour fades over the scene this long, replacing veil-duration's 0.9s.
